briefing: Outpost Ridgeback watches the most peaceful stretch of the northern frontier. For thirty-two years the ceasefire with the Varn Directorate has held, and the soldiers posted here joke that the biggest threat is boredom.
This morning, Private Tomas Halden's squad has one job: the dawn patrol of the north fence.
Nobody at Ridgeback knows that, forty kilometres north, Directorate armour has been moving all night.
story_objective: Survive the first hours of the invasion.
gameplay_objective: Patrol the fence, restore communications, repel the assault, recover the cipher book and fall back to the south gate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Northern Frontier. Outpost Ridgeback. The quietest posting in the Republic.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three years of ceasefire. Nobody believed the Directorate would ever cross the line.

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: Halden! Kell! Boots on. North fence, same as every morning.

lines.speaker: marek
lines.text: Into the truck! Go, go, go!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At 06:14 the Directorate crossed the frontier along two hundred kilometres.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Outpost Ridgeback held for thirty-one minutes. Twenty-two men were stationed there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nine of us made it to the truck.

objective.text: Patrol the north fence with Sgt. Marek

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Same fence as yesterday, Sarge?

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Same fence as every day. Keep your eyes open anyway.

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Birds went quiet about an hour ago. Don't like it.

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: Fence is intact. Quiet as always.

on_complete.speaker: kell
on_complete.text: Told you. Nothing ever happens up here.

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: Comms just dropped. Halden - HQ roof, reset the relay. Now.

objective.prompt: Hold [E] to reset the radio relay
objective.text: Reset the radio relay on the HQ roof

on_complete.speaker: bastion
on_complete.text: ...Ridgeback, this is Bastion, do you read--

on_start.speaker: bastion
on_start.text: Ridgeback, Bastion! Missiles inbound on your position - take cover, take cover!
MISSILE STRIKE

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: INCOMING! Get down! Get the fuck down!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Shit, the north tower's gone! Pavel was up there!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Where the hell is it coming from?! I can't see a damn thing!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Missiles! They're hitting every fucking thing at once! Stay down!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Bunker two is gone... Jesus, they're all gone.

on_complete.speaker: voss
on_complete.text: Oh shit. Armour! Tanks on the north ridge!

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: Here they come! Everyone up! Move your asses, get to the sandbags!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Sappers at the fence! Shit, they're setting charges!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Shoot them! Kill those bastards before they blow the fence!
THE FENCE IS BREACHED

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: They're through! Fuck! Every man on the line - FIRE!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: There's too many of them! There's too fucking many!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Keep firing, damn it! Make every shot count!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Tank! Left side! Shit, it's aiming at the bunker!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Medic! MEDIC! Man down! Oh god, man down!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Second group at the breach! Twenty, maybe more! Bloody hell!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: I'm almost out! Somebody throw me a fucking magazine!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Hold on! Hold on, damn you! Just a little longer!

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: We can't hold here! Fuck it - fall back to the hangar! GO!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Tomas! This way, behind the trucks! Move it!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Tanks at the breach! Shit, shit, they're coming in!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Get away from the walls! They'll bring the whole damn roof down!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Doran's hit! Fuck! Doran's hit!

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Leave him! He's gone! Keep fucking shooting!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: They're flanking us on the left! Bastards!

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: The hangar's lost! Halden - the cipher book in HQ! Move your ass!

objective.prompt: Hold [E] to take the cipher book
objective.text: Recover the cipher book from HQ

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: They're in the motor pool! Hurry the hell up, Tomas!

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: Got it? Good. Now get on the line - we hold HQ!

objective.text: Hold HQ until the truck is ready

on_start.speaker: bastion
on_start.text: All Northern Sector units, Line Kesh is your rally point. Trucks are at the south gates.

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Hold HQ until the truck is ready! Nobody runs until I fucking say so!

on_start.speaker: voss
on_start.text: Tank! Shit! It's coming right through the motor pool!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: We're not getting out of here, are we?

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Not if you keep talking! Shut up and SHOOT!

on_complete.speaker: bastion
on_complete.text: All Northern Sector units: fall back to Line Kesh. I repeat, fall back.

on_complete.speaker: marek
on_complete.text: That's it! Screw this - everyone to the south gate! The truck's waiting!

objective.text: Fall back to the south gate

on_start.speaker: marek
on_start.text: Don't look back! Keep moving! Get to the damn truck!

on_start.speaker: kell
on_start.text: Tomas, come on! Leave them! There's nothing fucking left!
